sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm back in my hotel room after a long day.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My phone needs a charge, so I plug it in.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, the socket by my bed doesn't work.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Does your charger work anywhere else?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Yes, it worked at the airport this morning.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, let's check the room before we try another charger.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: There's a lamp by the bed, but it's off too.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Can you check if the lamp's plugged into that socket?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Yes, it's plugged in, but there's no power there.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Thanks, we'll get someone to look at that socket.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I head down to speak to the same receptionist.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I borrow an adapter while I wait for help?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Sure, we've got one here that you can use.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I charge my phone down here for a bit?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Of course, there's a socket next to the front desk.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Great, I'll sit here until my phone has some power.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You can borrow it overnight, but we'll need it back by ten tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what time do you need the adapter back?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: By ten tomorrow morning.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I plug my phone in and see the screen light up.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's charging now, thanks for helping me out.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: We'll let you know when someone's checked the socket.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Should I contact reception if the socket still doesn't work?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, call us from your room and we'll help.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Can I leave the adapter in the drawer when I leave?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Please bring it back here so we know you've returned it.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Okay, I'll bring it back to this desk tomorrow morning.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: You're welcome to wait here while your phone charges.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks, I'll stay nearby and keep an eye on it.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I've got a way to charge my phone tonight.
